pending_terms.condition_context: ly Dividend Amendments pass and the Second A&R STRC CoD is timely filed and effective, as described further below. See “Conditional Dividends”. Conditional Dividends As previously announced, the Company has scheduled a special meeting of stockholders to be held on October 28, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. Eastern time (including any adjournment or postponement thereof, the “Special Meeting”), to consider a proposal to amend and restate the certificates of designations governing STRC (the “Second A&R STRC CoD”) and certain of the Company’s other series of preferred stock to provide for a regular dividend record date on each calendar day, with the related dividend, if declared, payable on the next following business day (the “Daily Dividend Amendments”). The daily dividends on STRC described above (the “November Daily Dividends”) will be payable only if both of the following events occur (the “Contingent Dividend Condition”): (a) the Daily Dividend Amendments have been approved by the Company’s stockholders at the Special Meeting at or prior to 5:00 p.m., New York City time, on October 31, 2026; and (b) the Second A&R STRC CoD has been filed and become effective at or prior to 12:01 a.m., Eastern time, on November 1, 2026. If the Contingent Dividend Condition is satisfied, i.e., both the Daily Dividend Amendments pass and the Second A&R STRC CoD is timely filed and effective, then the November Daily Dividends will be payable, and the dividend on STRC which the Company declared on September 30, 2026 (payable on November 15, 2026 to stockholders of record as of 5:00 p.m., New York City time on October 31, 2026) (the “November 15 Dividend”), will not be payable. If the Contingent Dividend Condition is not satisfied, the November Daily Dividends will not be payable, the November 15 Dividend will be payable, and the Company expects, subject to approval by its board of directors, to declare dividends on STRC with record dates in the month of November following the current semi-monthly cadence under the existing STRC certificate of designations. assumptions.note: Current STRC outstanding requires verified retirement/outstanding evidence. Repurchases alone are not retirements; dependent service and runway metrics remain unavailable while that evidence or complete history is missing.

runway_at_rate_ceiling.note: Framework §IV.5: STRC rate ratchets monotonically upward over multi-year horizons (sticky on recovery). Each ~125bp stress cycle consumes ceiling headroom; at 14-16% Strategy plausibly elects dividend suspension over further hikes.

cash_runway.cash_source: 8-K 0001193125-26-462151 (USD Reserve; legacy cash_and_equivalents key retained for compatibility)
cash_runway.note: Cash runway represents months until Strategy must begin BTC sales assuming ZERO new issuance inflow (no STRC issuance, no MSTR ATM). In practice, Strategy continuously refills cash via preferred issuance + ATM; this is a stress-scenario watermark. See strc.md §IV and mstr.md §II for the analytical framing. Cash position is stale-by-date — refresh on each new 10-Q + transaction 8-K disclosure.

sequenced_runway.note: Sequenced model: cash funds Phase 1, BTC sales fund Phase 2. Assumes ZERO new issuance refill (no STRC, no MSTR ATM). The total_operational_timeline_years field is barely distinguishable from runway_years_flat_btc (Phase 1 is months, Phase 2 is decades) — the load-bearing field is btc_sale_start_date_approx / phase1_cash_months. See cash_runway block for the parallel short-term watermark and runway_years_flat_btc for the parallel long-term solvency framing. See strc.md §IV.View 1 for analytical context.

risk_flags.message: STRC trading at $93.60 (below $95) — discretionary soft-floor watch. Under the 06-29 revised dividend policy a rate hike is NOT automatic; it is one of several discretionary defenses (alongside the $1B STRC-priority buyback, USD Reserve management, and BTC monetization) evaluated across price, yields, spreads, BTC, and reserve coverage. Sub-par still warrants watch, but do not assume a reset-driven hike.
